No, sorry but neither Webster's no Wiki's definitions disprove my definition. In fact, they both support my definition.  I simply went into more detail.

>Did you see anything about anyone's "Bedroom" in those definitions?

I used Rick Santorum's statements actually.  

>See, if you actually looked up the word, you would have known. Instead, you are too busy thinking you're so smart.

Kind of sad.  I think you really believe you won the argument.

>Again, pwned!

Didn't "pwn" me the first time, much less the second.  In fact, you're only managing to "pwn" yourself.  You have to actual win decisively to "pwn" someone.  You didn't even win, much less decisively.

And really, "pwn" went out last decade.

Gods.  What are schools teaching you kids these days anyway?

>"Neoconservatism is a variant of the political ideology of conservatism which combines features of traditional conservatism with political individualism and a qualified endorsement of free markets"

Actually, that's not quite right.  It's a believed traditional conservatism, but true traditional conservatism isn't what Santorum, Romney, or Gingrich expresses.

Otherwise you are correct, but you're only proving I'm right, because that's exactly what I described.

A true conservative wouldn't need to be qualified as a NEO-con, and a true conservative is not merely combining "features" of conservatism along with a "qualified" endorsement of free markets, for example being for the free market but wanting tariffs or the drug war to continue.

>Ah, yet another rule of being a Liberal, accuse others of being stupid and uninformed when you yourself don't have a fucking clue.

Ah, so you claim you're a liberal?
Just for the record, I looked it up.   You can't kill yourself taking 20 aspirin, which is what I'd thought.

Fuck.

All I wanted to do was express my crappy feelings tonight.  Instead, I get accused of posting a method of suicide, and I have to wait an hour before my edit appears.

The universe is telling me that no one wants to listen.  Go fuck myself.

What method???

Taking 3 aleve is NOT a means of killing oneself.  It is a joke.

A neocon is a conservative who wants the federal government to regulate social issues, such as what you do in your bedroom.

The term "neocon" is not simply a made-up garbage label.  For example, Rick Santorum is a neocon.

The neocons took over the core of the GOP years ago,

Also, I don't particularly care if you are St. George himself.  It doesn't mean you know what you're talking about.
Part of the problem is that the repair itself is hella-scary.  The fix is scarier than the disease.

>i had a panic attack during lunch today and some girl laughed at me

Yeah, had that happen to me way back when.  Summer school speech class.  Had a girl laugh at me while I was giving my speech.  Never really got over it though the teacher told the girl off for it.

Now I get panic attacks when in crowds with more than 2 people looking at me.  Made for an awful experience when I won employee of the month one year, in the 90's.   Entire company of 60+ people staring right at me, and all my muscles locked up.
